transcript.answer: The threshold is the `LORE_FACT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` environment variable, with a default of 0.92 cosine similarity. It is specified in FR-2.3 of specs/temporal-fact-invalidation/spec.md. The check is implemented in `invalidateContradictions()` in `facts.ts` (libs/server-core/src/work/memory/facts.ts), which T004 and T006 in tasks.md describe. I read this from the specs and task list only; I could not read the source code, so I have not confirmed the literal constant in `facts.ts`.
